description: sdd-spec-auditor Phase 1 pre-pass: one item per detection-pattern hit, state = {hit: {file, line, text, context}} where context is the hit line with ~3 lines around it. Only categories visible from one line: contradictions between documents (CAT-05), evolution risks (CAT-08) and transport over-specification (CAT-10, which depends on whether a requirement demands the route) skip the triage and go straight to the auditor.

category.instructions: The line `hit.text` of the specification file `hit.file` matched a defect search pattern. Read it with `hit.context`. Which specification defect does it show, if any?

criteria.CAT-01: Ambiguity: a vague or unquantified term (reasonable, fast, several, if possible) where the spec needs a precise value or condition
criteria.CAT-02: Implicit rule: behavior the system must have that is assumed or mentioned in passing but never stated as a rule
criteria.CAT-03: Dangerous silence: a failure, timeout, limit or edge case whose outcome is left undefined
criteria.CAT-04: Semantic ambiguity: a term used with a different meaning, or a synonym used instead of the glossary term
criteria.CAT-06: Incomplete specification: a placeholder, TBD, TODO, empty section or missing required element
criteria.CAT-07: Weak invariant: a business constraint stated only in prose, without a formal invariant or check
criteria.CAT-09: Implicit decision: a technology or architectural choice stated as fact with no ADR behind it
criteria.not_a_defect: The matched word is used correctly here; the line is precise, narrative, or already covered
